messages:
Ana: Morning — quick ops rundown for Sunrise priv-gateway handover tomorrow 10:00am PT. Main open areas: egress strategy for SIEM, KMS key ownership/rotation, IAM least-priv enforcement, audit log retention. Can we surface any blockers by EOD?
Lee: Network update — firewall rules staged. Need confirmation on egress IP strategy: Sunrise prefers us to allow their SIEM collector IPs, but they also asked for dynamic IPs via their cloud provider. I'd recommend forcing egress through our NAT (static IP). @Ana do we have their compliance signoff for NAT?
Bhavna: KMS note — Sunrise requested HSM-backed CMK. We support customer-managed keys via our KMS-proxy; the only gap is we need their KMS policy to allow our proxy service principal kms:Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey. I'll share a minimal policy snippet in a sec. Rotation default is 90d unless they require yearly rotation for compliance.
Tom: IAM — current mapping gives role 'priv-gateway-ops' broad read/write. I propose tightening now to the following minimal actions for runtime nodes:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["logs:CreateLogStream","logs:PutLogEvents"],"Resource":"arn:aws:logs:*:*:log-group:/redwood/sunrise-*"},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:PutObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::sunrise-priv-logs/*"},
    {"Effect":"Deny","Action":["s3:*"],"Resource":"*"}
  ]
}
```
Tom: I'll push a policy PR to staging after a quick test.
Jordan: Renewal risk flag — Sunrise mentioned cost pressure and asked about SLA uplift if they see >150ms p95 for 1st week. That's a medium risk for renewal if we don't set clear escalation paths and cost controls. Capture as action: define fallback model variant + cost alerts.
Ana: Action list so far: 1) Lee confirm NAT egress & share NAT IPs with Sunrise (due today EOD). 2) Bhavna send KMS policy template + rotation plan to customer (due tomorrow AM). 3) Tom create IAM policy PR and run staging smoke tests (due today EOD). 4) Jordan capture renewal concern and draft mitigation offer (SLA playbook + cost caps) by COB.
Lee: Quick datapoint — if we route via NAT, we should add a small egress bandwidth cap to avoid surprise bill spikes. I'll add a config note to the runbook.
Bhavna: KMS policy snippet I will send (example):
```json
{"Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-kms-proxy"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],"Resource":"*"}]}
```
Bhavna: Also asking security if HSM attestation docs are needed — cc @Tom for any infra constraints.
Tom: No infra blockers, but we need to ensure key aliases are propagated to prod before cutover. I'll add propagation check to deploy-bot smoke script.
deploy-bot: [notification] smoke-check: iam-policy-pr on staging passed (3/3 tests). CI run 7965432170.
Ana: Thanks — I'll consolidate these items into a short follow-up note and ping Sunrise PM for signoff. Also will record the renewal risk in our CRM and link the playbook. Meeting tomorrow 10:00am PT — agenda: handover checklist + final signoff. :thumbsup:
Jordan: I'll prepare the SLA uplift options and a short cost/runbook one-pager to present.
Ana: Perfect. If any new blockers pop up, drop them here and I'll triage.
